# 03-release — cut a rig release and bring its consumers along

One run is one release: the commit and the number planned, the tag pushed by a person and the release checked, then each consumer told what to do. No stage pushes a tag, publishes a release or edits another repository: a person does, from what the stage prepared.

Stages, in order; inputs, outputs and checks for each are in [CONTEXT.md](CONTEXT.md):

1. [Plan](stages/01_plan/CONTEXT.md) — which commit, which number, what is in it.
2. [Publish](stages/02_publish/CONTEXT.md) — a person tags; the release run and its assets are checked.
3. [Follow](stages/03_follow/CONTEXT.md) — what the farm portal, rigs, the example project and the guide must do.
